_comment: Registry of RL policies selectable from the RL web page's dropdown.
Hand-maintained: add an entry when you export a new .onnx into rl_policy/
id             stable key used by the API/UDP link (kebab/underscore, no spaces)
name           human label shown in the dropdown
model          checkpoint / training run description (2nd dropdown column)
type           'blind' (proprioceptive only) or 'camera' (needs a height scan)
obs_dim        expected observation width; the node validates the loaded onnx
uses_heightmap true if the obs includes the 187-ray height scan
runnable       false if it cannot run through the current RL launcher
which this launcher does not start -- see realsense_d435i_plan.md)
path           onnx path, relative to rl_policy/ (or absolute)
The backend also reports a computed 'available' flag (whether the file exists).
